$description: Lane A guitar bank. Two-level selection mirroring the legacy: per-genre `genreStyles` lists guitar STYLE names (legacy config.json#defaultStyleMappings.guitarPatterns) — the generator picks one style via ctx.rng.fork('patterns/guitar') — and `styleMarkers` maps each style to the substring marker(s) used to filter guitarPatterns.json by pattern name (legacy GuitarPatternGeneratorClass.js's e[0].indexOf(<marker>) !== -1 switch). A genre with a single style skips the style-pick draw (determinism-stable, identical musical result).

$legacySource.notes: The legacy switch maps `funk`->'Jazz', `latin`->'Pop', `playful`->'Pop' — the dedicated 'Funk'/'Latin'/'Playful' filter lines are COMMENTED OUT in the legacy source (guitarPatterns.json carries 0 'Latin'/'Playful' names; 'Funk' names exist but the active line uses 'Jazz'). We port the ACTIVE legacy behaviour verbatim. brightPop / organicVibes ARE the renamed legacy popTight / popLoose (docs/62 A4, fixed 06-20): both casperaki1 and casperaki2 map popTight/brightPop -> [country,pop,rock] and popLoose/organicVibes -> [arpeggio,funk,jazz]. The earlier 'no legacy entry -> [pop]' mapping was a porting error that missed the popTight->brightPop rename and shrank both pools.
